intents.name: Delay status
intents.definition: Customer asks whether/how much their train is delayed, or reports a delay seeking information.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Questions about delay length, arrival impact, reasons for lateness.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Cancellations go to cancellation_status; pre-travel will-it-run goes to live_departure_info.

intents.name: Cancellation status
intents.definition: Customer asks whether a service is cancelled or reports a cancellation seeking confirmation/next steps.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Is it cancelled / why cancelled / train disappeared from boards.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Rebooking questions go to rebooking_alternative_route; money questions go to refund_delay_repay.

intents.name: Live departure information
intents.definition: Pre-travel or general timetable/service questions: will it run, on time, platform, engineering works, strike effects.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Running today, on-time checks, platform, planned works, strikes, timetable queries.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Specific delay duration goes to delay_status; confirmed cancellations go to cancellation_status.

intents.name: Rebooking / alternative route
intents.definition: Customer wants to change trains/times/routes or find another way to get somewhere (replacement buses included).
intents.inclusion_criteria: Which train instead, next service, replacement transport, rerouting.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Using the SAME ticket on another operator goes to ticket_acceptance.

intents.name: Ticket acceptance
intents.definition: Can I use my existing ticket on another service, operator, route or time without buying again.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Cross-operator validity, ticket restrictions, peak/off-peak validity.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Changing the booking itself goes to rebooking_alternative_route.

intents.name: Refund / Delay Repay
intents.definition: Money back: Delay Repay claims, refunds for cancelled/unused tickets, compensation.
intents.inclusion_criteria: How to claim, eligibility, refund routing (incl. third-party sellers).
intents.exclusion_criteria: Changing tickets goes to rebooking; booking problems go to booking_ticket_issue.

intents.name: Booking / ticket issue
intents.definition: Buying, booking references, collection, seat reservations, advance tickets, upgrades for purchase, e-tickets, travel policy (bikes, luggage).
intents.inclusion_criteria: Can't collect, wrong reference, missing reservation, upgrade purchase, app/website booking, policy questions.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Refunds go to refund_delay_repay; using ticket elsewhere goes to ticket_acceptance.

intents.name: Lost property
intents.definition: Items left, lost or found on trains or at stations.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Left bag/phone/coat, lost-property office contact, found items.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Complaints about staff handling go to general_feedback unless the ask is finding the item.

intents.name: Onboard / station experience
intents.definition: Specific problem with the journey environment: wifi, food, cleanliness, staff conduct, comfort, facilities, lounge.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Wifi down, no food, dirty carriage, staff behavior, seat comfort, lounge access/facilities.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Pure venting without a specific problem goes to general_feedback.

intents.name: General feedback (praise / venting)
intents.definition: Praise, thanks, or venting with NO specific actionable request — including sarcastic 'thanks'.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Thank-yous, compliments, pure complaints, sarcasm, banter with staff.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Any message containing a specific question goes to that intent (tie-break: specific question always wins).
